scope: Laleli Mosque in Istanbul with the striped late Ottoman stone prayer hall, two single-balcony minarets, raised plinth, arcaded courtyard and fountain. The mosque stands above the historic vaulted bazaar.

originalReview.notes: Recorded eastern approach view shows mixed sandstone and brick, several levels of arch and oculus fenestration, the lead dome and drum, side gallery, and carved single minaret balcony.

quallaSearch.notes: The 2026 Qualla photograph byte-matches the original signed own-work CC0 release by Александр Сигачёв. No supplemental imagery was necessary.
